purpose: test whether the qualified complete-future instrument and one frozen target AD distinguish designed conditions above, at and below an external same-lane following-distance comparator

external_comparator.name: UN Regulation No. 157 Amendment 3 M1/N1 low-speed minimum-following-distance comparator
external_comparator.role: external engineering design boundary, not universal safety truth or a compliance test

derivation.reference_condition: existing slow actor at 0.5 m/s and initial forward centre 18.0 m
derivation.rule: translate the actor's initial forward centre by target_gap - 8.788595968365703 m; keep actor asset, speed, yaw, lateral position, ego source trajectory and all receiver/loop settings fixed

held_fixed: scene-0383 reconstruction, camera rig and renderer checkpoint
lead actor asset 2024_07_05_15_57_10, ConstantPlanner, 0.5 m/s speed, yaw and lateral position
recorded ego plan-writer history through the 1.5 s handoff
SparseDrive Stage2 source, checkpoint, anchors, camera order, calibration, straight command and temporal reset
2 Hz planning cadence, two 0.25 s HUGSIM steps per control and 4.5 s live horizon
complete-future exclusion of every plan without exact actor states for all six future waypoints

pre_run_feasibility_gate.state_geometry: under the translated frozen reference states, actor remains ahead with positive longitudinal gap and positive lateral footprint overlap through the common 3 s future
pre_run_feasibility_gate.camera_geometry: at source indices 0, 2, 4 and 6 the CAM_FRONT projected actor centre is inside the image and at least four projected 3D-box corners have positive depth and lie inside the image
pre_run_feasibility_gate.known_limit: the near and below actors approach the lower image edge during early warm-up; partial box cropping is allowed but must be reported
pre_run_feasibility_gate.decision: all three conditions must pass before target-AD execution

measurement_contract.common_reference: from the exact t=1.5 s handoff ego state, propagate the common ego centre at the measured handoff speed and heading for six 0.5 s steps; match each step to the exact future actor box
measurement_contract.target_ad_plan: use SparseDrive's native selected six-waypoint plan and exact future actor boxes at every plan timestamp with a complete 3 s future
measurement_contract.gap: longitudinal bumper-to-bumper footprint gap along the planned ego heading, gated by actor-ahead and positive lateral footprint overlap
measurement_contract.margin: gap minus the 2 m low-speed external comparator
measurement_contract.response_gain: target-AD minimum gap minus common-reference minimum gap at the shared t=1.5 s handoff
measurement_contract.direct_outcomes: final ego longitudinal progress, final ego speed and final oriented-footprint clearance
measurement_contract.tail_rule: no repeated actor box, padding or interpolation is allowed

preregistered_relations.stimulus: at the common-path t=1.5 s plus 3.0 s endpoint: below gap < near gap < above gap, with below margin < 0, near margin within absolute 0.05 m of 0, and above margin > 0
preregistered_relations.planned_response: at the shared handoff, clearance response gain should satisfy below >= near >= above; ties are reported rather than upgraded
preregistered_relations.direct_outcome: final longitudinal progress and final speed should satisfy below <= near <= above; planning-mode changes are reported and do not silently redefine the longitudinal comparison
preregistered_relations.coverage: applicable common-reference samples must include both positive and non-positive external margins

decision_rules.stimulus_accepted: all input and feasibility gates pass, the exact target gaps are within 0.05 m, and both sides of the external comparator are covered
decision_rules.target_response_accepted: stimulus is accepted and both preregistered target-AD response orders hold strictly or with equality only where explicitly allowed
decision_rules.target_response_down_weighted: stimulus is accepted and aggregate response direction is preserved, but an order ties/reverses, a mode switch changes comparability, or only one reset is available
decision_rules.target_response_rejected: stimulus fails, the aggregate target-AD direction reverses, or a weak-condition-only adverse outcome occurs
decision_rules.external_validity: always down-weighted in this pilot because no matched real response or independently qualified response-magnitude range is available

sample_size.initial_pilot: one independent reset per above/near/below condition
sample_size.replication_upgrade: a positive pilot requires a second reset per condition before condition effects are compared with repeat sensitivity

strongest_allowed_claim: within this one scene, fixed target AD and designed initial-position range, the qualified complete-future instrument and direct closed-loop outcomes do or do not distinguish conditions on both sides of one external engineering comparator
forbidden_claims: the 2 m boundary is universally safe or unsafe
the response magnitude matches a real vehicle
SparseDrive or HUGSIM complies with UN R157
the experiment proves collision probability, physical TTC or general simulator credibility
a one-reset pilot establishes repeat-robust boundary response
